resource: Wheel of Destiny slots of one Character
allocation_impact: A fixed [u16; 36] in memory; slot rows CHECK slot BETWEEN 1 AND 36 and receipt vectors have cardinality 36; a slot is at most its capacity (50..200), so a Character holds at most 4 x 1000 = 4000 points (allocated_total CHECK).
boundary_tests: max=36: slots 1..36 are stored and the ruleset reader requires exactly 36 topology slots
max+1=37: slot 37 fails the slot CHECK and an adjacency entry naming slot 37 refuses the ruleset
notes: WHEEL-0 §4 and §8; tests: character_wheel::tests::a_malformed_catalogue_is_refused, slots_and_occurrences_are_bounded. Registered by WHEEL-W1.
